composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-102a, "230V AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL") is a distribution schedule for the aft 230V AC panel. Three incoming supplies (AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2), each passing through its own earth-leakage breaker, split into two breaker columns (Q1-Q6 and Q7-Q17) each feeding one named load. Each load name identifies the equipment it serves per the class-specific rule: the load names Oven, Dishwasher, Washing Machine, Dryer, Steam Oven, Zip Water Dispenser, Maserator, Diving Compressor, Wine Cooler Galley, Galley Outlets (Extractor), Nav. Station Outlets, Port/Stbd Crew Outlets, Lazarette Outlets, Blast Chiller, and Induction Hob map to distinct galley/utility/outlet equipment nodes. The panel bus/supply topology (three incoming feeds + earth leakage breakers + bus splits) is infrastructure belonging to the AC distribution panel node, not to any one load.

facts: Panel drawing GMMS 108'-102a, titled '230V AFT DISTRIBUTION PANEL'.

Three incoming feeds: AFT OUTLETS, GALLEY 1, GALLEY 2, each entering through its own dedicated earth-leakage breaker (Earth Leakage 1, 2, 3 respectively), with conductor-size callouts ('16') on each incoming line — these are wire-gauge annotations, not devices.

Earth Leakage 1 (AFT OUTLETS feed) — netlist shows it bound to nets but its downstream distribution to a breaker column is not clearly traced on this sheet (AFT OUTLETS label itself is UNBOUND in the netlist).

Earth Leakage 2 (GALLEY 1 feed) supplies the common rail net4/net5 feeding Q7, Q8, Q9 (Maserator, Diving Compressor, Wine Cooler Galley) and also ties into the Q1-Q6 column supply per shared conductor labels (net38/39/41).
Earth Leakage 3 (GALLEY 2 feed) supplies the common rail net12/net13 feeding Q16/Q17 (spare/Induction Hob) and ties into shared conductors net353/net394 with Earth Leakage 2.
Left breaker column Q1-Q6 (32A/25A/16A ratings) feeds named galley/utility appliances: Oven, Dishwasher 3kW, Washing Machine, Dryer, Steam Oven, Zip Water Dispenser.

Right breaker column Q7-Q17 (mostly 16A, Q17 50A) feeds Maserator, Diving Compressor, Wine Cooler Galley, Galley Outlets (Extractor), Nav Station Outlets, Port/Stbd Crew Outlets, Lazarette Outlets, Blast Chiller, two spare ways (Q15, Q16 shown as unlabelled '/' positions), and Induction Hob.
Q15 and Q16 in the right column are drawn as spare/unlabelled breaker ways (shown as '/') — no load connected; these are SPARES for future installation, not uncertainties.

Common rail net8/net9 links Q1, Q4, Q5, Q6 conductors together with Dryer/Zip Water Dispenser labels — indicating a shared supply conductor segment across the Q1-Q6 column rather than fully isolated per-breaker feeds.

discarded_as_clutter: Title block repeat (DWG No., DATE, DRAWN, PROJECT, CUSTOMER, copyright notice) — meta, not equipment data
Wire-gauge diamond callouts ('16') on incoming supply lines — conductor size annotations, not devices
net305 PROJECT=CUSTOMER — spurious netlist artifact from title block text, not a real electrical connection

Duplicate label bindings (e.g. 'OVEN = OVEN', 'DRYER = DRYER', 'WASHING MASHINE = WASHING MASHINE', 'STEAM OVEN = STEAM OVEN', 'ZIP WATER DISPENSER = ZIP WATER DISPENSER', 'DIVING COMPRESSOR = DIVING COMPRESSOR') — self-referential label ties from OCR/legend duplication, not new information
good_to_have: Exact breaker ratings for each load are printed directly on the sheet next to each device (Q1 32A, Q2 25A, Q3-Q16 mostly 16A, Q17 50A) — read directly at inspection if needed.
Earth leakage breaker ratings/trip values not detailed beyond symbol presence — read at inspection.
Conductor gauge ('16') printed on incoming supply lines — read at inspection if cable sizing is needed.
uncertainties: AFT OUTLETS incoming feed and Earth Leakage 1 are UNBOUND in the measured netlist (no conductor path traced downstream on this sheet) — cannot state with certainty which breaker column/loads Earth Leakage 1 ultimately supplies; treat as unresolved on this sheet.

Q15 and Q16 in the LEFT breaker column (Q1-Q6 area, per one region-read table) appear duplicated/misattributed against the RIGHT column's Q15/Q16 spares — the region-read tool output listed Q12-Q17 twice under different columns; the drawn image and netlist confirm Q15/Q16 (right column, spares) and Q17 (right column, Induction Hob) are the authoritative rows — the duplicate left-column listing is a read artifact, not a second physical breaker set.

No register node fits 'BLAST CHILLER' exactly; it has been provisionally attached to 580-frigomar-refrigerator (refrigeration category) as the closest match, but this is NOT a confirmed engineer mapping — engineer should confirm whether Blast Chiller warrants its own node or belongs elsewhere.

Correspondence between 'GALLEY 1' vs 'GALLEY 2' feed and which specific breaker column (left Q1-Q6 vs right Q7-Q17) each earth-leakage breaker exclusively serves is not fully established by a clean 1:1 netlist read — shared conductor labels (net38/39/41, net353/394) show both Earth Leakage 2 and 3 touching overlapping nets, so exact feed-to-column exclusivity is not confidently measured on this sheet.
